maintainer: Member 2 - Legal Research & Verified Support Database
note: Official portals used for verification, what each is good for, and quirks found during research.

portals.name: Sindh Code - Law, Parliamentary Affairs & Criminal Prosecution Department, Government of Sindh
portals.use_for: Official Sindh Acts, Ordinances, Rules and Gazette publications (English, Urdu, Sindhi).
how_to_navigate: Sindh Code index: https://sindhlaws.gov.pk/SindhIndex.aspx (alphabetical, departmental, chronological, by Assembly tenure).
Alphabetical Acts: https://sindhlaws.gov.pk/Alpha.aspx?pg=ACT (paginated with JavaScript postbacks - browse manually).
quirks: The departmental listing for the Labour Department shows only the 2021 amendment Acts, not the principal 2015-2019 Acts - use the Labour Department site for those.
The site has its own 'Sindh Laws AI' chatbot - worth knowing for the project pitch (how our agent differs: verified helplines and step-by-step routes).
Some LawDocument.aspx pages and PDFs refuse automated tools (robots.txt) - open them in a browser. Copies under https://www.sindhlaws.gov.pk/Setup/Publications_SindhCode/ were readable on 2026-10-17.

portals.name: The Pakistan Code - Ministry of Law and Justice
portals.use_for: Federal laws (PPC, PECA, federal labour laws, Cantonments Rent Restriction Act, Constitution).
how_to_navigate: Category-wise search (e.g. Labour Laws, Rent Laws) and year filter on the home page.
Gazette notifications: Document Retrieval System https://drs.molaw.gov.pk/
quirks: The PPC, CrPC and CPC pages are marked 'Under Review'.
Disclaimer: content is for information only; the Gazette notification prevails.
Law URLs are encoded strings (e.g. .../english/UY2FqaJw1-...-sg-jjjjjjjjjjjjj); copy them from the site.

portals.name: Human Rights Department, Government of Sindh
portals.use_for: Human rights complaint cell, official list of Sindh helplines (introduction page), PDFs of rights-related Sindh Acts.
how_to_navigate: Attached bodies (incl. Sindh Human Rights Commission): https://humanrights.sindh.gov.pk/attached-offices
quirks: Member and Secretary tables on the home page contain placeholder data (dummy names and '0092 1234567') - never scrape contacts from those tables. Other sindh.gov.pk department sites built on the same template (e.g. SCPA) have the same placeholders.

The helpline list (introduction page) still links SCPA's old complaint form (scpa.sindh.gov.pk/forms/submit), which returned 404 on 2026-10-17. The department's own complaint system is at https://humanrights.sindh.gov.pk/complains (Register / Login).
Never copy numbers from click-to-call links on government sites - use the printed text (the Mohtasib Sindh site's phone link points to an unrelated number).

portals.name: Labour & Human Resources Department, Government of Sindh
portals.use_for: Official PDFs of all Sindh labour laws, minimum wage notifications, labour complaint form.
quirks: Some notification PDFs are scanned images (no machine-readable text) - read them manually.

portals.name: Provincial Assembly of Sindh
portals.use_for: Acts exactly as published after assent (newest laws appear here first, e.g. Sindh Act No. XVIII of 2026).
how_to_navigate: Act PDFs follow the pattern https://pas.gov.pk/uploads/acts/Sindh_Act_No.<roman>_of_<year>.pdf (older ones use spaces).

portals.name: Sindh Judicial Academy - Updated Laws
portals.use_for: Compiled texts with all amendments incorporated (used for the SRPO 1979 and the workplace harassment Act).

portals.name: High Court of Sindh - case law and Judges' Library
portals.use_for: Judgments showing how provisions are applied (time limits, forums); compiled law texts from the Judges' Library (sindhhighcourt.gov.pk).
quirks: Judgments confirm practice but are not the law's text - prefer the Act for provisions.
